{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk camisole, straight cut, midi length, midnight blue (#191970), fluid woven silk.
Wool-blend trousers, tapered leg, ankle length, charcoal gray (#36454F), matte heavy wool.
Structured blazer, boxy fit with dropped shoulders, hip length, deep emerald green (#046307), textured tweed.
Block-heel pumps, almond toe, moderate height, forest green (#228B22), smooth leather.
Delicate pearl choker necklace and small gold hoop earrings.

This outfit works because the structured, oversized blazer creates a horizontal line that visually conceals the belly while adding a sophisticated layer appropriate for an evening club setting. The deep, dark colors of the silk top and wool trousers feel rich under artificial lighting without demanding excessive attention, aligning with her wish to avoid being the center of focus. By choosing tapered trousers rather than flared silhouettes, the look streamlines the lower body further, ensuring the overall silhouette remains sleek and unobtrusive despite the formal occasion."}
